items.title: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Could Be 90% Undervalued Following The Marvell Deal
items.summary: Why Lumentum’s stock is suddenly tied to Marvell Lumentum Holdings (LITE) is back in focus after Marvell Technology agreed to buy the photonics group in an all stock deal that values Lumentum at roughly US$115b, with shareholders receiving 4.5 Marvell shares for each Lumentum share. Lumentum Holdings has swung sharply lower in the short term, with the share price down about 54% over 30 days and 43% over 90 days.
